niche_preference_profile: This user most consistently prefers interfaces that feel clear, readable, and intentionally organized: strong information hierarchy, simplified structure, open spacing, restrained controls, and calm visual tone. They often favor light backgrounds with dark text, softer card treatments, fewer competing headings, and layouts that reduce clutter while keeping key content easy to scan. They also repeatedly prefer explicit form guidance and labels, clearer grouping of related content, and polished modern styling that feels refined without being loud or overly dramatic.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers clear, easy-to-scan hierarchy with prominent titles, distinct grouping, strong section separation, and fewer competing headings or modules.
Prefers interfaces where text is easy to read quickly: stronger text/background contrast, larger or clearer labels, and more immediately legible cards and body copy.
Prefers cleaner compositions with fewer decorative elements, less interface noise, and reduced visual complexity.
Prefers layouts with more whitespace, calmer spacing between elements, and less crowded stacking.
Prefers explicit labels, persistent field names, visible placeholders/examples, and form structures that make purpose clear before interaction.
Prefers muted secondary actions and less aggressive CTA emphasis, avoiding overly bright toggles, pills, links, or buttons that compete for attention.
Prefers related content consolidated into unified, well-grouped containers rather than fragmented panels, scattered modules, or awkwardly separated sections.
